grammar.title: There be 句型
lines: 构成(一般现在时)： There be(is, are) + 地点 § "There be" 结构帮助我们描述了物体的位置和存在。动词 "be" 的形式将根据主语的单复数而变化也会随时态的变化而变化（There was/were）。同时，可以通过添加其他的修饰词或从句来扩展句子，使描述更加详细。 后置定语的翻译语序(倒着翻译) 仿写课文 There " Be " 怎么变(就近原则)
有 拥有 have
存在 There be...
"There be" 是英语中的一种特殊句型，用来表示某个地方存在或发生了某人或某物。它通常用于描述事物的存在状态或位置。
该句型的基本结构是：There + 动词 "be" + 存在的人或物 + 其他补充信息。
There is a cat on the roof.（屋顶上 有 一只猫。）
There are two books on the table.（桌子上 有 两本书。）
There is one in my heart . 那有一个人在我心里。 我心里有一个人。
There is a cooker in the kitchen . 那有一个炉灶在厨房里。 厨房里有一个炉灶
There is a fridge in the kitchen . 那有一台冰箱在厨房里。 厨房里有台冰箱
There are two chair s in the kitchen . 那有2把椅子在厨房里。 厨房有2把椅子
Lily’s bedroom is large. 总结
1、被描述的物品 There is a bed in the bedroom.
2、物品颜色 It is brown.
3、具体位置 And it is in the middle of the room.
4、物品状态 It is very clean …
There is a table and four chairs
There are four chairs and a table.
There are some students and a teacher.
There is a teacher and some students.

sentences.title: 冠词练习
lines: 特殊疑问词 where + be + 名词 (Where is/are + 名词?) in 在…里面 Where is the money? 钱在哪儿？ 冠词练习
Where are you? 你在哪？
Where is your mother? 你妈呢？
Where is your car? 你车呢？
the money in the bag 包里的那钱
The money is in the bag. 钱在包里。
Where is it? 位置 状态
There is a cup on the table. The cup is clean.
There is a box on the floor. The box is large.
Give me a book. Which book? the book on the table.
Give me a glass. Which glass? the empty one.
Give me / some cups. Which cups? the cups on the table.
Is there a book on the table? Yes, there is.
Is there a knife in that box? Yes, there is.
